name: NIST CSF 2.0
description: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 outcomes across Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: Govern
requirements.summary: Organizational cybersecurity risk strategy, policy, roles, and supply-chain oversight.

children.title: Cybersecurity policy established
children.summary: Leadership approves and communicates written cybersecurity policies.

children.title: Roles and accountability
children.summary: Named owners are accountable for cybersecurity controls and risk decisions.

children.title: Supply chain risk management
children.summary: Vendors and subprocessors are reviewed for security criticality and residual risk.

requirements.title: Identify
requirements.summary: Asset visibility, risk assessments, and vulnerability identification.

children.title: Hardware and cloud asset inventory
children.summary: Managed computers, cloud stores, and repositories are inventoried with owners.

children.title: Risk and vulnerability assessment
children.summary: Security risks and software vulnerabilities are scored and tracked to treatment.

requirements.title: Protect
requirements.summary: Identity controls, training, data protection, and platform hardening.

children.title: Identity and MFA enforcement
children.summary: Identities use MFA and least-privilege entitlements reviewed on schedule.

children.title: Workforce awareness training
children.summary: Personnel complete annual security awareness training with recorded proof.

children.title: Data security at rest and transit
children.summary: Sensitive stores enforce encryption, private access, and retention safeguards.

children.title: Configuration and change control
children.summary: Cloud configurations and production code releases follow reviewed baselines.

requirements.title: Detect
requirements.summary: Continuous logging and adverse event analysis.

children.title: Continuous monitoring and audit logs
children.summary: Cloud trails and security alerts monitor infrastructure for anomalous changes.

requirements.title: Respond and Recover
requirements.summary: Incident management, root-cause analysis, and tested continuity recovery.

children.title: Incident response execution
children.summary: Security incidents are logged, triaged within SLA, and closed with root cause.

children.title: Recovery plan execution
children.summary: Disaster-recovery plans and failover drills confirm RTO and RPO targets.
